en.title: Largest Square Area of All 1s
en.description:
In a 01 matrix, find the axis-aligned squares consisting entirely of 1s and return the largest area.

This site has made the standard input and output explicit; any range not given by the source is marked as this site's protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n m, followed by n 01 strings of length m. 1≤n,m≤300.
en.explanation: Example 1: there is an all-1 square of side 2 in the middle, so the largest area is 4. Example 2: everything is 0, so output 0; the original site's second 2×2 input was missing a row, which has been filled in. Example 3: there are only two rows, so the largest side is 2 and the area is 4.
hints: Use a row-rolling DP: when the current cell is 1, the largest side of a square with it as the bottom-right corner is the minimum of the left, top, and top-left values plus 1.
